home.project.title: A project in development. An idea open to new possibilities.
home.project.question: Can we better understand how people move in order to make better decisions about the spaces we share?
home.project.paragraph1: We explore technologies such as LiDAR, IoT, edge computing and data analysis to build new tools to understand and manage the flow of people.
home.project.paragraph2: We are currently in research and development: building simulations, exploring applications and looking for real environments to validate our ideas.
home.project.paragraph3: We want to connect with people who share this interest: organisations that manage spaces and events, researchers, developers and technology companies.
